title.zh: v1.4.0 和弦工坊层级重构折叠支持与星云子曲风专业级视觉重塑
title.en: v1.4.0 Chord Studio Reorder/Collapse & Pro-Audio Galaxy Redesign

highlights.zh: 和弦走向创作工作台布局前置与折叠收起：将和弦创作工作台置于常见分类和弦走向之上，支持一键折叠/展开；折叠态提供极简走带光效摘要栏（实时和弦卡片、BPM与音色速览、独立循环播放），下方卡片点击「载入工作台」自动展开并平滑吸顶
highlights.en: Chord Progression Builder repositioned above catalog with smart collapse/expand: streamlined header with instant playhead summary bar, active chord tags, and auto-expanding anchor link from curated cards

highlights.zh: 星云子曲风全界面专业级视觉重塑：彻底清除衬线字体（Noto Serif），统一升级为现代几何无衬线字体（Space Grotesk）；重构子曲风卡片为双层发光玻璃拟物卡，全面剔除生硬圆点，引入微型霓虹光环与脉冲粒子星核；升级曲风分支抽屉顶栏与交互按钮
highlights.en: Galaxy subgenre showcase pro-audio aesthetic overhaul: eliminated clunky serif fonts, upgraded to sleek Space Grotesk sans, replaced raw dots with luminous neon core rings and cybernetic badges, and enhanced glassmorphism cards

title.zh: v1.3.8 分享链接严格白名单与超限恶意攻击防护
title.en: v1.3.8 Sequencer Share Whitelist & DoS Vulnerability Hardening

highlights.zh: 分享链接白名单与上限校验（P0-17）：严格校验 URL base64 载荷，对 tracks ≤16、步数 4–64、BPM 20–300、Swing 0–100、步进值 0..3 建立完备数据校验与白名单机制；杜绝超限恶意 payload（如巨量轨道、stLen=1e9、负数步进）造成的页面卡死与 DoS 拒绝服务隐患
highlights.en: Strict URL share whitelist & bounds validation: enforces hard limits on tracks (≤16), steps (4–64), BPM (20–300), swing (0–100), and step values (0..3); rejects malicious DoS payloads (1e9 steps, negative step indices, oversized tracks)

highlights.zh: 分享异常链路保护与空链接拦截：编码失败时返回空值并弹出友善失败提示，彻底阻断复制 ?groove= 无效空链接
highlights.en: Share generation guard & clipboard fallback: prevents blank ?groove= link generation and clipboard pollution upon invalid sequencer states

title.zh: v1.3.7 小节跳转状态解耦与组件卸载定时器全面回收
title.en: v1.3.7 Independent Bar Selector State & Timer Unmount Lifecycle Guard

highlights.zh: 小节跳转下拉菜单独立状态（P0-11）：播放过程中用户选定小节不再被 currentStep 步进时钟强行覆盖；暂停时自适应呈现当前停靠小节，彻底解决恒定显示 Bar 1 的状态失步
highlights.en: Independent bar navigation selector state: user manual bar selection during playback is preserved without playhead step clock overrides; accurately displays current paused bar instead of freezing at Bar 1

highlights.zh: 异步定时器卸载生命周期保护（P0-12）：为步进扩展平滑滚动、长按交互及通知 Toast 建立统一引用生命周期，视图切换卸载时严格回收全部未结定时器，根除内存泄漏风险
highlights.en: Timer lifecycle & unmount safety guard: captured and cleared all pending timers across step auto-scroll, long-press gestures, and toasts on unmount

title.zh: v1.3.6 首帧语言同步初始化与网页标题双语持久化
title.en: v1.3.6 Synchronous First-Frame Language Init & Bilingual Title Sync

highlights.zh: 首帧语言防闪烁同步解析（P1-12）：在 React 首帧渲染前同步读取 localStorage 或系统语言，消除英文与国际用户首屏闪烁中文文本（FOUC）的体验缺陷，避免多余二次重渲染
highlights.en: FOUC elimination via synchronous language resolution: read localStorage/navigator before first React render to prevent 1-frame Chinese flash for international users and redundant mount re-renders

highlights.zh: HTML 根标签与标题动态绑定：在 index.html 注入首屏同步轻量脚本并在语言切换时动态同步 document.title 与 lang 属性
highlights.en: Dynamic HTML lang & title binding: synchronized document.title and document.documentElement.lang on bootstrap and language toggles

title.zh: v1.3.5 步进网格单元记忆化重构与奇数拍复合节拍音律修正
title.en: v1.3.5 Step Cell Memoization & Odd-Meter Backbeat Correction

highlights.zh: 步进单元粒度记忆化（P2-01 / P2-02）：抽离独立 React.memo <StepCell> 与稳定事件回调引用，将播放期间网格重渲染 DOM 量降低 93.75%，杜绝高低端移动设备在极速 BPM 下的丢帧与微卡顿
highlights.en: Granular Step Cell memoization: isolated React.memo <StepCell> with stable callback references, reducing playback DOM reconciliation by 93.75% to eliminate frame drops

highlights.zh: 奇数拍与复拍子常规反拍落点理论修正（P0-10）：重构智能填充（Smart Fill）算法，针对 3/4（华尔兹）、6/8（复二拍）、5/4（3+2 拍）、7/8（2+2+3 拍）及 2/4 精确匹配乐理骨干军鼓反拍与底鼓强拍
highlights.en: Odd-meter & compound meter backbeat placement: reworked Smart Fill rhythm engine with music-theoretically accurate snare backbeats and kick downbeats for 3/4, 6/8, 5/4, and 7/8 meters

highlights.zh: 多小节步进力度数组边界保护：修复 24/32 步扩展小节时力度数组未自适应轨道步长导致超出 16 步访问失效的隐患
highlights.en: Multi-bar velocity array bounds guard: guaranteed velocity buffer matches expanded 24/32 track step lengths to prevent undefined velocity reads

title.zh: v1.3.4 基础设计系统动效补全与滚动条原子样式修复
title.en: v1.3.4 Design System Animation & Scrollbar Utilities Fix

highlights.zh: Tailwind 关键帧与入场动效补齐（P1-03）：补全 animate-fade-in、animate-slide-up 与 animate-slide-left 动画令牌，弹窗与卡片平滑淡入
highlights.en: Tailwind keyframe & animation tokens: implemented missing fade-in, slide-up and slide-left animations across modals and view transitions

highlights.zh: 跨浏览器滚动条原子类标准化（P1-03）：补齐 no-scrollbar、scrollbar-none 与 custom-scroll，消除各视图滚动条样式异常
highlights.en: Cross-browser scrollbar utilities: added no-scrollbar, scrollbar-none, and custom-scroll classes across all horizontal and vertical views

title.zh: v1.3.3 声学星系 WebGL 上下文恢复与后台节能优化
title.en: v1.3.3 Sonic Galaxy WebGL Context Recovery & Background Energy Saver

highlights.zh: WebGL 上下文丢失与平滑恢复（P1-04）：监听 webglcontextlost 与 webglcontextrestored，自动暂停与恢复渲染循环，杜绝显卡重置导致页面白屏
highlights.en: WebGL context loss & recovery: listening for webglcontextlost / webglcontextrestored with graceful render loop restart

highlights.zh: 后台标签页能耗节约机制（P1-04）：页面切入后台时暂停 requestAnimationFrame 粒子演算，恢复聚焦时无跳帧续播，极大降低移动端发热与能耗
highlights.en: Background tab power saving: automatically halts 3D RAF loop when tab is hidden, saving battery & GPU on mobile

title.zh: v1.3.2 听力大师音频引擎生命周期修复与盲听防泄题保护
title.en: v1.3.2 Ear Challenge Engine Lifecycle Fix & Blind Test Leak Guard

highlights.zh: 听力挑战音频引擎生命周期修复（P0-19）：消除难度切换时的双触发问题，切换难度与卸载时深度回收旧 AudioContext 实例，彻底杜绝实例泄漏
highlights.en: Challenge audio engine lifecycle guard: eliminated difficulty double-trigger, added strict stop() & destroy() audio context cleanup

highlights.zh: 盲听测试防泄题保护（P0-20）：答题前隐藏速度线索（TEMPO CLUE），杜绝利用 BPM 与分类提早猜中答案，恢复 100% 盲听有效性
highlights.en: Blind test spoiler protection: hidden tempo clue during quiz until answered, ensuring 100% blind listening validity

title.zh: v1.3.1 曲风详情页深度编曲档案与全局搜索快捷键强化
title.en: v1.3.1 Genre Detail Arrangement Dossier & Search Shortcut Guard

highlights.zh: 曲风详情页全字段展示（PRD 5.6.1.2）：补齐核心配器（Instrumentation）、典型曲式（Structure）、音色调制（Sound Design）、和弦转位（Inversions）、核心律动（Rhythm DNA）、先锋音乐人（Artists）与制作秘诀
highlights.en: Complete genre production dossier: rendering instrumentation, arrangement structure, sound design, chord inversions, rhythm DNA, pioneering artists, and pro tips

highlights.zh: 全局搜索快捷键平台适配（P0-23）：Header 快捷键根据系统动态展示 ⌘K / Ctrl K，全局 Esc 键退出窗口
highlights.en: Search shortcut platform adaptation: dynamic ⌘K / Ctrl K indicator in header, reliable window-level Escape key dismissal

title.zh: v1.3.0 双曲风锁相实时同步试听与通道监听路由系统
title.en: v1.3.0 Dual Groove Synchronized Audition & Live Channel Routing

highlights.zh: 双曲风锁相实时同步试听（PRD 5.7.2.3）：曲风 A 与曲风 B 跨网格小节对齐，单引擎实例混音驱动，消除多时钟飘移
highlights.en: Dual groove phase-locked audition: sample-accurate sync playback of Genre A & B within unified audio engine

highlights.zh: 声轨监听通道路由矩阵：支持【A+B 混合】、【仅曲风 A】、【仅曲风 B】与【仅骨架鼓组】即时独奏静音切换与状态指示
highlights.en: Channel routing matrix: instant switching between A+B Mix, Solo A, Solo B, and Drums Only with visual active badges

highlights.zh: 动态同步调速控制台：支持 BPM 步进增减、滑块微调、原曲速度与平均速度一键吸附，兼具 16 步硬件级 LED 走带走位跟踪
highlights.en: Synchronized tempo console: ±2 BPM steppers, slider, tempo snaps (A, B, Avg), and 16-step LED playhead tracker

title.zh: v1.2.0 全局 URL 深链路由与工作台全状态撤销重做系统
title.en: v1.2.0 Deep Linking URL Router & Full Studio State Undo/Redo

highlights.zh: 全局 URL 深链路由系统（P1-08）：支持地址栏双向联动、历史记录前进/后退、以及直接通过链接分享或书签收藏任意视图与曲风（?tab=galaxy / ?tab=detail&genre=detroit-techno）
highlights.en: Bidirectional URL deep linking & browser history navigation: bookmark or share any view & genre directly

highlights.zh: 工作台全状态撤销/重做快照引擎（P0-17）：撤销重做覆盖范围扩展至速度 BPM、摇摆度 Swing、拍号、精度、欧几里得生成与静音独奏状态，音频底层无缝同步
highlights.en: Full studio state Undo/Redo engine: captures pattern, BPM, swing, meter, quantize, and mute/solo states with audio engine synchronization

highlights.zh: 键盘快捷键防冲突保护（P0-16）：表单输入框、下拉菜单与可编辑区域深度隔离，彻底防止 Space 播放键误劫持输入
highlights.en: Hotkeys isolation: comprehensive input & select field guard preventing Space key conflicts during text editing

title.zh: v1.1.1 星谱光线投射对齐修复与中英文布局基线锁定
title.en: v1.1.1 Galaxy Raycast Alignment & Layout Baseline Lock

highlights.zh: 修复 3D 星谱（GalaxyView）在非全屏导航栏下 64px 纵向坐标偏移：修正射线拾取、悬浮标签与视口投影几何
highlights.en: Resolved 64px vertical projection offset in GalaxyView 3D canvas raycasting and HTML labels

highlights.zh: 建立中文宽度设计基线：中英文切换严格保持布局网格与宽度一致，英文过长统一采用精炼缩写与省略截断，杜绝布局漂移
highlights.en: Locked Chinese text width as UI design baseline; English labels use compact terms & truncation to prevent layout shifts

highlights.zh: 引入容器级 ResizeObserver：自适应屏幕方向旋转、视口缩放与侧边栏抽屉展开收起
highlights.en: Integrated container ResizeObserver for seamless viewport resize and orientation changes

title.zh: v1.1.0 移动端横竖屏深度优化与在线更新系统
title.en: v1.1.0 Responsive Mobile/Landscape Architecture & Update System

highlights.zh: 新增「检查更新」与「更新记录」：支持一键在线检测最新版本、即时对比与热更新提示
highlights.en: Added Check for Updates & Release Notes drawer with live version check and one-click reload

highlights.zh: 移动端横屏硬件机架级沉浸体验：针对 360px-450px 低矮横屏深度压缩顶栏与轨道间距，一屏纵览 8 轨全矩阵
highlights.en: Mobile landscape hardware groovebox mode: ultra-compact transport bar and auto-collapsed dossier

highlights.zh: 移动端竖屏人体工学优化：步进单元 44px 黄金触摸靶区，紧凑轨道控制，底部 Safe Area 防遮挡保护
highlights.en: Mobile portrait ergonomic tuning: 44px touch targets, compact track headers, iOS safe area insets

highlights.zh: 和弦工作台一键导入编曲台：从和弦进行库直达 Studio 和弦轨道，快速开启全曲编创
highlights.en: One-click Chord Import to Studio: seamlessly transfer progression voicing into studio chord track

title.zh: v1.0.2 步进编曲与核心交互稳定性修复
title.en: v1.0.2 Sequencer Timing & Core Interaction Bugfixes

highlights.zh: 修复 StudioView 正在播放时小节跳转下拉菜单不断跳变的问题（viewedBar 解耦）
highlights.en: Fixed bar navigation dropdown jitter during playback by decoupling viewedBar state

highlights.zh: 修复多拍子（Polymeter）步进光标位置对齐：视觉光效与实际发声节拍严格同步
highlights.en: Fixed polymeter playhead alignment: visual indicator strictly synchronized with audio playback

highlights.zh: 统一输入事件模型为 Pointer Events，彻底根除移动端触摸与合成点击双重触发问题
highlights.en: Unified touch/pointer input model, eliminating synthetic double-triggering on mobile devices

highlights.zh: 盲听挑战赛题优化：未作答前隐藏速度线索与选项流派详情，修复初次静音播放问题
highlights.en: Blind challenge hardening: hidden tempo clues & metadata before answer, user gesture audio start

highlights.zh: 横向时间线线性年代轴修复：消除 1920 与 1940 重复过滤，完整补齐 1950 年代
highlights.en: Timeline linear scale fix: eliminated duplicate bins and completed the 1950s decade column

highlights.zh: 曲风详情页切换曲风时 BPM 同步重置，优化速度输入框退格与防抖
highlights.en: Genre detail BPM state synchronization and buffered smooth numerical input

highlights.zh: 新增全局 ErrorBoundary 赛博朋克风格错误保护兜底卡片
highlights.en: Added cyberpunk ErrorBoundary fallback card with retry and reset mechanisms

title.zh: v1.0.1 音频引擎架构强化与防爆音重构
title.en: v1.0.1 Audio Engine Hardening & Anti-Clipping Overhaul

highlights.zh: 重构欧几里得节奏算法：采用 Bjorklund 迭代余数分组，输出正统均匀节奏分布
highlights.en: Rebuilt Euclidean algorithm using iterative Bjorklund distribution matching world rhythms

highlights.zh: 加入 DynamicsCompressorNode 主通道母带级压限器，8 轨齐鸣 0 爆音
highlights.en: Master limiter with DynamicsCompressorNode, preventing digital clipping on heavy tracks

highlights.zh: 实现 Active Voice 注册表与 5ms 平滑渐弱 Panic 机制，彻底杜绝切歌悬挂音与爆鸣
highlights.en: Active voice registry and 5ms gain ramp panic system, eliminating hanging notes and clicks

highlights.zh: 统一主线程与 Web Worker 音频时钟，移除无效 Tone.Transport 假时钟
highlights.en: Unified audio clock bridge between Web Worker and main thread, removing fake transports

highlights.zh: 收录 150+ 世界音乐流派与纯正节拍律动档案
highlights.en: Curated library of 150+ music genres with authentic cultural contexts and rhythms

highlights.zh: 专业 8 轨步进鼓机编曲工作台（带力度、三连音、概率与参数锁定）
highlights.en: Professional 8-track step sequencer with velocity, ratchets, probability, and p-locks

highlights.zh: 3D 星系图谱、双流派 AB 对比视窗与盲听耳力训练场
highlights.en: 3D Galaxy view, dual-genre compare matrix, and blind ear training challenge arena
